jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 26b (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/ci-hooks.mjs, tools/contracts-verify.mjs, tools/safety-commands.mjs, tools/verify-local-runner.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/swarm/train3). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/ci-hooks.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/ci-hooks.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 174 `try { child.kill(sig); } catch { /* already gone */ }`: SILENT-ESRCH — killGroup's fallback single-process kill after the process-group kill failed; the target having already exited is expected.

### tools/contracts-verify.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/contracts-verify.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 18 `try { process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL'); } catch { /* gone */ }`: SILENT-ESRCH — killAll cleans up the mock-server/test child process groups after contract verification; the group having already exited is expected.

### tools/safety-commands.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/safety-commands.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 58 `runs.push({ id, status: (await readState(root, id)).status })`: LOG-ALWAYS — feeds the panic-button's listRuns/stop path; a non-run directory is plausible, but any other failure (corrupt state.json, permission) must be logged since silently dropping a run here means the stop command can't cancel it.

### tools/verify-local-runner.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/verify-local-runner.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 44 `child.kill('SIGKILL')`: SILENT-ESRCH — the verify timeout kills a child that may already have exited on its own between timeout and kill call; ESRCH ('process may already be gone') is expected, log any other kill failure (e.g. EPERM).

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
